issue.title: Add actuator control to offboard plugin

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Implementation of set_actuator_control method due to https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/pull/771#pullrequestreview-256231538.

I think that this solution most corresponds to [mavlink message](https://mavlink.io/en/messages/common.html#SET_ACTUATOR_CONTROL_TARGET) specification compared [first PR](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/pull/771).

Also in protobuf3 "0" is the default for numeric types so this would hide the complexity.

The corresponding MAVSDK-Proto PR is [here](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Proto/pull/88).

issue.title: Log download via udp over ethernet stalls

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Hardware Setup: Holybro 6X <- eth -> Jetson Xavier

Using the code out of the logfile_download.py example I have no trouble downloading the full set of files with a serial connection.

However, when connecting over an eth connection downloads will start fine then always stall and never recover. 

In fact, the "connection" goes down fully and the only way to reconnect is to reboot the pix. I've run the mavsdk_server manually to watch its output and the only thing that happens is the heartbeats timed out message appears and then nothing.

The connection seems stable otherwise and works well when using mavlink-router to forward to a GCS over the network.
